question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.**

The sound of rain tapping against the window was a _________ (stimulating) melody, lulling him to sleep.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Subduing**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Stimulating **means exciting or invigorating. (रोमांचक या स्फूर्तिदायक)

 
 
• **Example**: *The stimulating discussion sparked creativity among the team.*
 
 
 
• So, the antonym would be a word that means calming or soothing.
 
• **Subduing **means calming or suppressing, making it the opposite of stimulating. (शांत करना या दबाना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The calming music had a subduing effect on the anxious crowd.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Stressful **means causing stress or anxiety. (तनाव या चिंता पैदा करना)
 
• **Troubling **means causing trouble or worry. (परेशानी या चिंता पैदा करना)
 
• **Harsh **means rough or unpleasant. (कठोर या अप्रिय)
